## Episode Thesis

In this episode, DI's Asia correspondent Johan Nylander reports from Hong Kong on how Asian and Chinese media are covering the spy and romance scandal around Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive. Chinese state media deny she works for Beijing and mock the US response. Nylander calls the scandal a 'wet blanket' over the coming Trump–Xi meeting. He also mentions new US Commerce Department rules targeting third-country data-centre rentals to Chinese firms, mainly in Malaysia, and says China may retaliate with its own trade barriers. No stock recommendations are made, and the mood is cautious and geopolitically uneasy.
